{{Top}}
'''Imperial Order D6-66''' was a law of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that required all [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] to have [[time-lock device]]s. This order even reached out to [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
